meta.title: Codex of Achrona — enriched product feed
principles: An empty allergen cell is unknown, not none.
Allergens are taken from the allergen cell or quoted from ingredients. They are not guessed.
Cheese or stremsel with no rennet source stays vegetarian: null.
Prep minutes stay null when the label gives no number.
Pine nuts are not filed as EU nuts. Gelatine species stays unknown.

definitions.vegetarian: Lacto-ovo. False if meat, poultry, fish, crustacean, or gelatine is listed. Null if rennet source or a nested stock is unstated.
definitions.gluten_free: free only when the allergen cell speaks (a list or geen) and no gluten source is present. An empty cell is unknown. Wheat in the ingredients overrides an empty cell.
definitions.quick: True only when the label states a time of 15 minutes or less, says “enkele minuten”, or the product is a ready-to-eat sandwich. Oven with no time is false.
definitions.high_protein: At least 15g protein per 100g, or eggs with a per-egg protein figure. Foods below that density are not ranked as protein foods.
